extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and practicing writers (local to Denver/Boulder or remote) looking for workshops, readings, retreats, camps, and other events
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog of upcoming writing workshops, readings, retreats, and camps offered by a local writing organization, showing metadata used by prospective participants to choose and register for events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event Title / Name
rubrics_metrics.description: The displayed name of the event (e.g., 'Hard Times Boulder', 'Visiting Author Series: Tackling Trauma and Taboo in the Personal Essay with Jenny Bartoy').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the primary identifier for the event; may indicate theme or series. Appears at top of each listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre / Focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Genre labels shown for each event (examples: 'All Genres', 'Fiction', 'Nonfiction/Memoir', 'Play/Screenwriting', 'Poetry', 'YA/Children's', 'Hybrid').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the creative-writing forms or audiences the event targets; helps prospective attendees select events aligned with their interests or projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date & Time
rubrics_metrics.description: The scheduled date and start/end time for the event (e.g., 'Tue, May 12, 2026 3:00pm - 5:00pm MDT').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential logistical information for planning attendance and assessing time commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue / Format
rubrics_metrics.description: Where and how the event is delivered (examples from page: 'Boulder Public Library', 'Hybrid (Denver or Zoom)', 'Zoom: Remote Participation', 'Beacon Hall', 'Lighthouse Denver', 'Historic Baranof Hotel, Juneau, Alaska', 'RM 316-317').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes in-person, hybrid, and remote events and provides location specifics; affects travel, accessibility, and experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Level
rubrics_metrics.description: Skill/experience designation for the event (explicitly shown as 'Intro', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced', or combinations thereof).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals suitability for writers at different stages; used to match participant skill level to workshop content and instructor expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor / Presenter
rubrics_metrics.description: The person(s) leading or presenting the event (examples: 'Several Instructors', 'Jenny Bartoy', 'Erika Krouse and Rachel Weaver', 'No Instructor').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructor identity may indicate pedagogy, prestige, or fit for attendees seeking particular mentorship or expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price / Membership Pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Cost information including separate Member and Non-member prices (e.g., 'Member: $0.00', 'Non-member: $5.00', 'Member: $2,150.00').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows financial commitment and membership benefits; influences accessibility and value calculation for prospective participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration Status / Availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration call-to-action and availability indicators such as 'Details', 'Register', 'Waiting List', 'Only 2 Seat(s) Left!', and 'Sorry, this class is full!'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conveys current capacity and urgency; affects whether a user can sign up immediately, must join a waitlist, or is blocked from attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event Type / Format Descriptor
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorical descriptor of the event's purpose or format (examples: 'Visiting Author Series', 'Book Launch', 'Retreat', 'Write-a-thon', 'Summer Camp').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicates the event's structure and goals (e.g., promotional reading vs. instructional workshop vs. intensive retreat), helping attendees choose based on intent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age Range / Target Age
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicit age targeting for youth programs (examples: 'Summer Camp for ages 7-10', 'Summer Camp for ages 11-13', 'Summer Camp for ages 14-18').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines appropriate participant age groups and is critical for caregiver decisions and program suitability.
